title: Reforesting the Black Forest — 10,000 Oaks by 2028
description: A reforestation initiative planting 10,000 native oak and beech trees in fire-damaged and bark-beetle-ravaged sections of the Black Forest, partnering with local forestry associations to ensure long-term stewardship.
motivation: Having grown up near Freiburg with the Black Forest as my backyard, watching it decline to climate stress over the past decade makes supporting its regeneration feel like a personal responsibility.

title: Emergency Shelter Kits for Displaced Families in the Horn of Africa
Hot Meals and Safe Spaces — After-School Program for 400 Children in Leipzig
description: An after-school program providing daily hot meals and supervised homework support to children in economically vulnerable neighborhoods across Leipzig, operated through a network of community centers.
motivation: Growing up in a family that relied on exactly this kind of community support, I want to give other children the same stability and sense of belonging that changed my life.

title: Digital Inclusion Labs for Long-Term Unemployed Adults in Stuttgart
description: Equipping community centers across Stuttgart with hardware, internet access, and certified instructors to deliver 12-week digital literacy courses to adults who have been out of the workforce for more than a year.
motivation: Watching family members struggle to re-enter the job market due to limited digital skills convinced me that targeted, practical training is one of the highest-return investments in human dignity I can make.

title: Mobile Palliative Care Units for Elderly Patients in Rural Baden-Württemberg
description: Funding the operation of two specially equipped mobile units staffed by palliative care nurses and physicians who reach housebound elderly patients in villages more than 30 km from the nearest hospital.
motivation: My years in healthcare policy showed me how profound the care gap is in rural areas; ensuring a dignified end of life for everyone, regardless of where they live, is a cause I cannot walk past.

title: Solar-Powered Water Purification for 15 Villages in Northern Kenya
description: Installing solar-driven reverse-osmosis water purification stations in 15 remote Kenyan villages, eliminating reliance on contaminated boreholes and reducing waterborne disease rates tracked against baseline health data.
motivation: After witnessing firsthand during a volunteer trip how water scarcity shapes every aspect of daily life, I wanted to channel the resources I have access to into a solution with measurable, lasting impact.

title: German Language and Integration Classes for Newly Arrived Refugees
description: Running intensive language and cultural orientation courses for recently arrived refugees across three German cities, with certified instructors and childcare provision so that parents can attend alongside younger adults.
motivation: Language is the key that unlocks every other opportunity — employment, healthcare, friendship — and I believe removing that barrier is one of the most effective gifts we can give to someone starting over.

title: Coral Reef Restoration and Marine Biodiversity Recovery in the Coral Triangle
description: Funding reef-gardening stations staffed by local dive teams who grow coral fragments on underwater nurseries and transplant them to degraded reef sections; progress is tracked via quarterly biodiversity surveys covering fish and invertebrate species counts.
motivation: Combining my passion for marine ecology with the financial capacity to make a tangible difference in one of the world's most biodiverse and threatened marine ecosystems feels like an obligation I embrace wholeheartedly.

title: Peer Support and Crisis Counseling for Isolated Elderly Citizens in Germany
description: Operating a staffed telephone and video counseling service for socially isolated elderly people across Germany, complemented by volunteer visitor training programs; currently serving over 1,200 registered callers per month.
motivation: Loneliness among the elderly is a silent epidemic that receives far too little attention; having seen its effects on my own grandparents, I give to this program because connection is as vital as medicine.

title: Clean-Water Wells and Sanitation Blocks for 20 Villages in Rural Tanzania
description: Financing the drilling of boreholes, installation of hand pumps, and construction of gender-separated sanitation blocks in 20 villages in the Dodoma region; 14 wells are operational and have provided safe water access to approximately 8,400 people to date.
motivation: The data is unambiguous — clean water is the single highest-impact health intervention available, and I wanted my giving to go where it creates the most measurable good for the most people.

title: Alpine Biodiversity Corridors — Reconnecting Fragmented Habitats in Bavaria
description: Co-funding the acquisition and ecological restoration of land parcels that will stitch together isolated forest patches in the Bavarian Alps into a continuous wildlife corridor, with lynx and wildcat recolonization as key success indicators; land surveys and first restoration works are underway.
motivation: Growing up hiking in the Bavarian mountains, I feel a deep responsibility to future generations to preserve the wild character of this landscape before fragmentation makes recovery impossible.

title: Vocational Training and Business Mentorship for Women Leaving Domestic Violence Shelters
description: Delivered 18-month vocational training programs in bookkeeping, tailoring, and digital administration to 143 women across four shelter networks in Saxony, with 91% achieving employment or self-employment within six months of completing the program.
motivation: Economic independence is the foundation of personal safety for survivors of domestic violence, and funding this program was my way of converting professional success into something that genuinely changes lives.

title: Zero-Emission School Canteens — Sustainable Kitchens Across 30 Baden-Württemberg Schools
description: Retrofitted 30 school canteens with induction cooking equipment, food-waste monitoring systems, and plant-forward menu redesign, achieving an average 62% reduction in per-meal CO₂ emissions and an 18% cut in food-waste volume across the participating schools.
motivation: Schools are where lifelong habits are formed; investing in sustainable canteens felt like the most leveraged way to reduce emissions and cultivate a generation of environmentally conscious citizens at the same time.

title: Emergency Food and Hygiene Kits for Flood-Displaced Families in Pakistan
description: Planned to pre-position and distribute emergency food parcels and hygiene kits to 5,000 families displaced by seasonal flooding in Sindh province, in partnership with an established local NGO network and logistics infrastructure.
motivation: Flood displacement can erase years of family stability overnight; I had committed to this project because rapid, targeted relief in the first 72 hours prevents cascading harm that would otherwise take years to recover from.

title: Urban Community Gardens and Food Literacy Program in Underserved Stuttgart Neighborhoods
description: Proposed to create eight raised-bed community garden plots in social housing estates across Stuttgart, paired with weekly cooking and nutrition workshops to improve food access and build community cohesion in areas with limited green space.
motivation: I live steps from one of these neighborhoods and see the hunger for green space and community; the proposal was a direct response to what residents told me they needed most.
